description: This file provides functions for interacting with Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), including URL normalization, screenshot capture, target creation, JavaScript evaluation, and DOM/ARIA snapshotting. It also manages external dependencies and exports key functions for browser automation.

methods.name: normalizeCdpWsUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a WebSocket URL for CDP, rewriting hostnames and protocols as needed.

methods.name: captureScreenshotPng
methods.description: Captures a full-page PNG screenshot via CDP.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot in specified format and quality via CDP.

methods.name: createTargetViaCdp
methods.description: Creates a new browser target via CDP, handling URL discovery and WebSocket connection.

methods.name: evaluateJavaScript
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript expression in the browser context via CDP.

methods.name: snapshotAria
methods.description: Takes an accessibility snapshot (ARIA tree) via CDP.

methods.name: snapshotDom
methods.description: Takes a DOM snapshot via CDP, returning nodes with attributes.

methods.name: getDomText
methods.description: Retrieves text or HTML content from the DOM, optionally filtered by selector.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Finds DOM elements matching a selector and returns summarized info.
